Every definition states what it is blind to, and tests/test_metrics.py demonstrates each blind spot rather than asserting it. | Referenced by Metric.definition on every family; the single source for what a metric name means. |
| `src/verification/psf_measurement.py` | PSF metric measurement -- Strehl, first null, encircled energy, residual L2. | src/verification/metrics.py (M2.4), one canonical definition each. |
| `src/verification/asm_oracle.py` | The repository's own float64 ASM/RS propagator (O2). Genuinely useful characterization evidence that must NEVER decide a gate -- L2-PSF-01 once set a negative-control floor from an O2 comparison and had to retire it as circular. | Oracle kind with independence SHARES_CODE, structurally barred from gating. |
| `src/verification/analytic.py` | The five closed forms promoted out of the retired A1 task set before it was deleted, each with the measured agreement against the pinned solver that its tolerance was derived from, the wrong answer that tolerance rejects, and where relevant what it deliberately does NOT separate. | Oracles of B1-RAY-EFL, B1-RAY-PLATE, B1-WAVE-GAUSS, B1-WAVE-AIRY and B1-WAVE-TILT, authored by M1.1 and M1.2. |
| `src/verification/fixed_suite.py` | The FIXED-V1 selection itself (CHE-135). The choice is the deliverable, so it lives in one reviewable place; a test rejects any justification reducible to "it already existed". | The versioned manifest under benchmarks/instances/. |
| `src/verification/hazards.py` | The two measured traps, with the numbers the mistaken code actually returns: Optiland's add_layer um/nm slip at 0.04216384 against bare glass's 0.04216456, and Chromatix's kykx meaning cycles-per-length on asm_propagate and radians-per-length on plane_wave with the displacement opposite in sign. Both report an `ok` contract, which is what makes them the archetype. | B0-UNITS-01 and B0-UNITS-02, authored by M1.3. |
| `src/verification/status.py` | The seven verification statuses, in their own module because both the family schema and the verifier need them. They exist separately because a pass/fail boolean cannot tell "the solver refuses this dtype" from "the approximation does not apply here" from "it ran and the number is wrong". | VerificationResult.status (M0.5.3) and BenchmarkFamily.failure_semantics. |
| `src/verification/declaration_ledger.py` | The one place that maps every registry declaration -- 52 assumptions, warnings, hard limits and invariants across six components -- to the evidence that it is not merely prose. Asserted complete in BOTH directions: a declaration with no entry is a gap, an entry whose declaration was edited or deleted is orphaned, and every evidence reference is resolved against the tree rather than trusted as a string. Closes the same completeness gap M1.3 and M2.4 each asked for separately. | B0-CONTRACT's declaration coverage and M2.4's invariant battery, from one source of truth rather than two hand-maintained lists. |
| `src/verification/evidence.py` | The join between an executed instance and a VerificationResult: run and verify, fit a convergence exponent WITH its slope standard error, judge a broken twin against the gate's own threshold, take ensemble statistics with ddof=1, hash a scientific fingerprint, and write a provenance-stamped record. It lives here rather than in runtime/ because the dependency has to run that way -- an executor that imported verification/ could grade its own run. | Every family driver under benchmarks/instances/; the shared half of what each of them would otherwise reimplement. |
| `src/verification/refusals.py` | The refusal catalogue: for every ContractCode, what triggers it, what would fix it, and which of the five negative outcomes it is. A test fails if a code has no entry or an entry names a code that no longer exists. | B0-CONTRACT's oracle, and the structured-refusal half of M3.2's discovery API. |
| `src/verification/result.py` | VerificationResult and its parts: Measurement (a number cannot be reported without an uncertainty and a basis), MetricResult carrying whether its tolerance may gate, declared-versus-observed validity, the negative-control outcomes including FIRED_BACKWARDS, and the structured diagnostic codes. No top-level pass boolean and no scalar score. | The structure every scientific verdict this project makes is reported in; schemas/verification_result.schema.json is generated from it. |
| `src/verification/verifier.py` | verify(family, instance, execution_record). Re-evaluates the family's validity predicates against the parameters the run actually realized rather than trusting the instance's declaration, and reads no committed record as truth. | The single entry point fixed evaluation and future RL both call. |
| `src/verification/families/__init__.py` | The family substrate's public surface (CHE-131). | Unchanged; grows as families are authored. |
| `src/verification/families/schema.py` | BenchmarkFamily, BenchmarkInstance, the four parameter kinds, the signed validity margin, and the oracle-independence and tolerance-gating rules enforced at construction. | The substrate M1/M2/M4 author against. |
| `src/verification/families/registry.py` | The one place that knows which families exist, with the family_id uniqueness rule that replaces the retired A1-* id-space collision test. | Unchanged. |
| `src/verification/families/predicates.py` | The already-measured validity bounds made executable: SI S3 curvature, per-axis Nyquist, ASM transfer-function sampling, capability intersection, hexapolar ring membership, declared planarity, Fresnel number, paraxial field angle. | Family validity tuples. |
| `src/verification/families/b0_contract.py` | The four B0 contract-and-recovery families (CHE-108) and their ten canonical instances, one per declared boundary. The five negative outcomes are each produced by a different instance, and B0-UNITS carries the two measured traps whose expected contract status is `ok` while the physics is wrong. | The contract layer of the evidence set; feeds M7.3's robustness suite. |
| `src/verification/families/b1_ray.py` | The five B1 ray-primitive families (CHE-106): EFL/BFL, plane-parallel plate, Snell with the TIR boundary as a validity predicate, the Lagrange invariant, and the off-axis pupil OPL whose omitted n_object * (d0 . r_launch) term recovered only 0.13% of the required tilt. | The ray half of the B1 evidence layer. |
| `src/verification/families/b1_wave.py` | The seven B1 wave-primitive families (CHE-107), including B1-WAVE-ASM-VALIDITY, whose entire subject is behaviour near the sampling boundary and which is what forces the validity margin to be signed and normalized. | The wave half of the B1 evidence layer. |
| `src/verification/families/b2_transitions.py` | The five B2 representation-transition families (CHE-109..CHE-112), and the WHAT_DOES_NOT_SURVIVE table naming what each coupler provably discards. B2-ROUNDTRIP makes "the deliberately broken twin ran" a validity predicate, so a round trip that cannot be made to fail reports OUT_OF_VALIDITY rather than a passing number. | The transition layer of the evidence set. |
| `src/verification/families/b3_composed.py` | The three B3 composed families (CHE-116). B3-PSF-SINGLET carries the unmet 1.0e-3 gate at 2.2072e-3 with every tolerance basis migrated verbatim from tolerances.yaml; B3-DEMO2 is the one composed case graded against an external published reference; B3-DUALROUTE gates on an intermediate invariant because no independent PSF route exists for the Cooke triplet. | The composed half of the validated evidence layer. |
| `src/verification/families/b4_characterization.py` | The B4 characterization families (CHE-134). Carries the DEMO3-RW-P why_not migrated unreworded from manifest.yaml, the cost model, and the attributed cross-route discrepancy on the Cooke triplet. None of them can gate, and the schema refuses the promotion rather than relying on the label. | The characterization layer; B4 never joins a required gate. |
| `src/verification/families/projection.py` | Projects registered families into claim_ledger Claims, so the coverage ledger is derived rather than typed twice. | Unchanged; the projection grows as families land. |
| `src/verification/__init__.py` | Package marker. | Unchanged. |

## Bucket B — candidate canonical case

| artifact | justification | destination in the new architecture |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `benchmarks/physics/L2-PSF-01/run_benchmark.py`<br>*the M3-SINGLET-REF prescription and its graph construction* | POSITIVE: this is the only composed ray-to-wave case in the repository with an independent analytic decider, and it is the case that carries the project's one open unmet gate. Freezing it keeps the residual investigation (CHE-117) anchored to a fixed physical setup, so a change in the number is attributable to code rather than to a moved prescription. Its scientific fingerprint is the regression signal for the whole ray-to-wave path. | B3-PSF-SINGLET-01, canonical instance, origin CANONICAL. |
| `benchmarks/instances/b0_contract.py` | POSITIVE: the ten canonical B0 instances, executed. This is the only place each of the five negative outcomes -- unsupported, invalid_configuration, out_of_validity, lossy_but_allowed, blocked -- is produced by a DIFFERENT shipping component refusing a real request, and the only place the two ok-contract-wrong-physics traps are re-measured on the pinned installs rather than read out of a record. Freezing it keeps the five statuses individually reachable rather than individually declared. **Three instances are graphs through GraphExecutor; the other seven are refused before a graph could run -- a capability intersection, a bridge policy, an artifact-level declaration -- and go through the shipping refusal path, which is what those questions are about.** | B0-CONTRACT / B0-DTYPE / B0-VALIDITY / B0-UNITS canonical instances, run by tests/test_b0_instances.py in the default gate. |
| `benchmarks/instances/b1_ray.py` | POSITIVE: the five B1 ray families executed against the shipping Optiland adapter, and the only place three load-bearing conventions of the traced record are written down executably -- that a collimated on-axis ray's transverse position at the first surface IS its launch position (which makes sin(i) = rho/R exact), that the image plane refracts, and that a traced focal length is not a paraxial one. Each of those had a wrong reading that produced a plausible number, and each is now a comment beside the code that depends on it. **Also carries the device/precision matrix (RAY-4) and the unsupported-request probe (RAY-5). B1-RAY-LAGRANGE's gate was NOT_MET at 1.3e-7 against 1e-10 and is now MET at 1.2e-15 against 1e-13, because the ORACLE was corrected rather than the tolerance widened: the finite-real-ray bilinear form is preserved only by a LINEAR symplectic map, so the gate is now the DIFFERENTIAL invariant on two independent tangent vectors, extrapolated to zero ray separation. The 1.3e-7 finite-ray number is retained as a non-gating characterization metric at its original 1e-10 threshold. The device/precision matrix's CPU-vs-CUDA agreement is measured on real hardware and persisted at benchmarks/probes/records/optiland/b1_ray_device_precision.json.** | B1-RAY-EFL / -PLATE / -SNELL / -LAGRANGE / -OFFAXIS-OPL canonical instances, run by tests/test_b1_ray_instances.py in the default gate. |
| `benchmarks/instances/b1_wave.py` | POSITIVE: the seven B1 wave families executed through the Chromatix graph node, and the only place three families were found unable to support their own claims -- GAUSS/TILT/FWDBWD sitting outside their own sampling predicate while meeting their gates, TALBOT unable to revive because a binary grating's high orders dephase, and ASM-VALIDITY unable to demonstrate aliasing because an 8 um beam's bandwidth is fifty times inside the grid's. Each diagnosis is a comment beside the parameter it changed, and no tolerance moved. **Also carries the device observation (WAVE-3), whose CUDA arm is measured on real hardware and persisted at benchmarks/probes/records/chromatix/b1_wave_device_observation.json: the placement is read from array_state on the live JAX array before jax.device_get, and the persisted .npy placement is recorded beside it as a contrast because host bytes report cpu for every run. Asserted by tests/test_b1_wave_gpu.py. The complex64 accuracy cost (WAVE-2) is measured once, by B0-DTYPE-01, against the independent float64 angular spectrum rather than twice. TALBOT's tolerance basis is the m^4 non-paraxial order dephasing (pi/2) m^4 (lambda/d)^2, and the driver decomposes it against a paraxial and an exact float64 kernel on the same grid rather than asserting it.** | B1-WAVE-GAUSS / -AIRY / -TILT / -PLANEPHASE / -FWDBWD / -TALBOT / -ASM-VALIDITY canonical instances, run by tests/test_b1_wave_instances.py. |
| `benchmarks/instances/b2_transitions.py` | POSITIVE: the four B2 transition families executed -- exact ray-to-wave, the route budget on two systems, the stochastic wave-to-ray estimator with its four evidence kinds in enforced order, and the round trip in both directions with both arms. Four constructions had to be corrected to get here and every one of them had already produced a plausible number: the reconstruction was owed the SI eq S5 1/N, enumerating a MAGNITUDE density is not the exactness limit, unbiasedness must be measured on a SIGNED linear functional against an independent probe rather than on a norm or against the field itself, and a centred real Gaussian probe cannot see either broken twin. No tolerance moved; two tolerance BASES were completed. **The three W2R blind spots are measured rather than asserted, and two of the six controls needed their own configuration to be observable at all -- normal_sign is exactly inert at z = 0 and the evanescent fraction is exactly 0 at that pitch, so both would have reported green.** | B2-R2W-EXACT-01, B2-R2W-ROUTE-{ONNODE,OFFNODE}-{01,02,04,08}, B2-W2R-STOCH-01 and the B2-ROUNDTRIP canonical instances, run by tests/test_b2_transition_instances.py. |
| `benchmarks/instances/b2_equiv.py` | POSITIVE: the patch/global equivalence anchor, the drawn convergence ladder, and the enumerated sub-aperture instance that separates "the estimator is wrong" from "the estimator has sampling error". It also records the family's most useful finding: the equivalence is exact where the patch mode grid and the oracle mode grid coincide and only there -- 1.7e-15 at the DOE plane against 0.84 at z = 1.26 mm, with neither route wrong. **Two of the three negative controls are exactly inert at full aperture -- coverage is 1 and the launch offset is 0 -- which is how a real A_patch/A_draw inversion survived. The anchor measures that blindness as a number and the sub-aperture instances gate the controls.** | B2-EQUIV-FULL-01, B2-EQUIV-SUB-{004,016,064,225} and B2-EQUIV-SUB-ENUMERATED, run by tests/test_b2_equiv_instances.py. |
| `benchmarks/instances/b3_psf_singlet.py` | POSITIVE: this is the substrate proof. It is the only place a real Optiland trace becomes a real ExecutionRecord and that record is handed to verify() against a real family, so freezing it keeps the loop -- family, instance, executor, verifier -- exercised end to end by the test suite rather than by a person remembering to run it. **It does NOT yet reproduce the 2.21e-3 frozen number, and does not claim to: 256 rings rather than 512, and a centred-half-window metric rather than the 5-Airy-radius radial-profile residual. Both differences are declared.** | B3-PSF-SINGLET-01, the canonical instance, and the replacement for benchmarks/physics/L2-PSF-01/run_benchmark.py once it reproduces the frozen fingerprint (CHE-115). |
| `benchmarks/probes/ray_wave/demo2_hologram.py` | POSITIVE: demo2 is the composed ray-wave case that DOES have an independent decider -- the full-aperture patch validated against an independent float64 ASM at 7.1e-13 -- so freezing it gives B3 a second decidable composed instance beside the singlet, on a different coupler route. | B3-DEMO2-01 canonical instance. |
| `benchmarks/probes/ray_wave/demo3_hologram_lens.py` | POSITIVE: the paper's Fig 5c system is the repository's only case at a scale where the composition has no reference of its own, which is exactly what a characterization family must be anchored to. Freezing it keeps B4-DEMO3's cost and variance numbers comparable across the optimization work (CHE-118/119/120) rather than drifting with the configuration. | B4-DEMO3 canonical instance -- characterization only, validation_target false, no gating tolerance. |
